"<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<project xmlns=\"http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0\"\n         xmlns:xsi=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance\"\n         xsi:schemaLocation=\"http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 \n         http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd\">\n    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>\n\n    <groupId>com.example</groupId>\n    <artifactId>logging-service</artifactId>\n    <version>1.0.0</version>\n    <packaging>jar</packaging>\n\n    <properties>\n        <maven.compiler.source>11</maven.compiler.source>\n        <maven.compiler.target>11</maven.compiler.target>\n        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>\n        <slf4j.version>1.7.36</slf4j.version>\n        <logback.version>1.2.12</logback.version>\n        <log4j.version>2.17.2</log4j.version>\n    </properties>\n\n    <!--\n        Align transitive logging versions across Spring Boot, Kafka, Elasticsearch and\n        Hibernate on a single SLF4J API + single Logback binding. Without this, Maven's\n        \"nearest wins\" rule can select an slf4j-api/logback pairing that a dependency's\n        binding jar was not built against, producing NoSuchMethodError on\n        StaticLoggerBinder at runtime.\n    -->\n    <dependencyManagement>\n        <dependencies>\n            <dependency>\n                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>\n                <artifactId>spring-boot-dependencies</artifactId>\n                <version>2.7.14</version>\n                <type>pom</type>\n                <scope>import</scope>\n            </dependency>\n            <dependency>\n                <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>\n                <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId>\n                <version>${slf4j.version}</version>\n            </dependency>\n            <dependency>\n                <groupId>ch.qos.logback</groupId>\n                <artifactId>logback-classic</artifactId>\n                <version>${logback.version}</version>\n            </dependency>\n            <dependency>\n                <groupId>ch.qos.logback</groupId>\n                <artifactId>logback-core</artifactId>\n                <version>${logback.version}</version>\n            </dependency>\n            <dependency>\n                <groupId>org.apache.logging.log4j</groupId>\n                <artifactId>log4j-api</artifactId>\n                <version>${log4j.version}</version>\n            </dependency>\n        </dependencies>\n    </dependencyManagement>\n\n    <dependencies>\n        <dependency>\n            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>\n            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>\n            <version>2.7.14</version>\n        </dependency>\n\n        <!--\n            kafka-clients and the Elasticsearch client only need the SLF4J facade, not a\n            binding. Excluding their transitive slf4j-api keeps the single copy pulled in\n            via spring-boot-starter-logging (version pinned above) as the one on the\n            classpath, instead of a second, differently-versioned jar of the same class.\n        -->\n        <dependency>\n            <groupId>org.apache.kafka</groupId>\n            <artifactId>kafka-clients</artifactId>\n            <version>3.5.1</version>\n            <exclusions>\n                <exclusion>\n                    <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>\n                    <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId>\n                </exclusion>\n            </exclusions>\n        </dependency>\n\n        <dependency>\n            <groupId>org.elasticsearch.client</groupId>\n            <artifactId>elasticsearch-rest-high-level-client</artifactId>\n            <version>7.17.13</version>\n            <exclusions>\n                <exclusion>\n                    <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>\n                    <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId>\n                </exclusion>\n            </exclusions>\n        </dependency>\n\n        <dependency>\n            <groupId>org.hibernate</groupId>\n            <artifactId>hibernate-core</artifactId>\n            <version>5.6.15.Final</version>\n        </dependency>\n\n        <!--\n            Logback (pulled transitively by spring-boot-starter-logging) is the single\n            SLF4J binding for this service. log4j-slf4j-impl was previously declared\n            alongside it, putting two competing org.slf4j.impl.StaticLoggerBinder\n            implementations on the classpath - the root cause of the NoSuchMethodError.\n            Do not add another SLF4J binding (e.g. log4j-slf4j-impl) without removing this.\n        -->\n\n        <dependency>\n            <groupId>junit</groupId>\n            <artifactId>junit</artifactId>\n            <version>4.13.2</version>\n            <scope>test</scope>\n        </dependency>\n    </dependencies>\n\n    <build>\n        <plugins>\n            <plugin>\n                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>\n                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>\n                <version>3.11.0</version>\n                <configuration>\n                    <source>11</source>\n                    <target>11</target>\n                </configuration>\n            </plugin>\n            <plugin>\n                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>\n                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>\n                <version>3.1.2</version>\n            </plugin>\n        </plugins>\n    </build>\n</project>", "structuredPatch": [{"oldStart": 20, "oldLines": 22, "newStart": 20, "newLines": 16, "lines": ["     </properties>", " ", "     <!--", "-        Align transitive logging versions across Spring Boot, Kafka, Elasticsearch and", "-        Hibernate on a single SLF4J API + single Logback binding. Without this, Maven's", "-        \"nearest wins\" rule can select an slf4j-api/logback pairing that a dependency's", "-        binding jar was not built against, producing NoSuchMethodError on", "-        StaticLoggerBinder at runtime.", "+        Pin the logging stack to one slf4j-api + one Logback + one log4j-api version so", "+        every transitive dependency (Spring, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Hibernate) resolves", "+        the same jars. Scoped to logging artifacts only, rather than importing the full", "+        spring-boot-dependencies BOM, which also manages unrelated artifacts (e.g. it", "+        would silently downgrade org.elasticsearch:elasticsearch from the 7.17.13", "+        requested below to 7.17.11).", "     -->", "     <dependencyManagement>", "         <dependencies>", "             <dependency>", "-                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>", "-                <artifactId>spring-boot-dependencies</artifactId>", "-                <version>2.7.14</version>", "-                <type>pom</type>", "-                <scope>import</scope>", "-            </dependency>", "-            <dependency>", "                 <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>", "                 <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId>", "                 <version>${slf4j.version}</version>"]}, {"oldStart": 55, "oldLines": 6, "newStart": 49, "newLines": 16, "lines": ["                 <artifactId>log4j-api</artifactId>", "                 <version>${log4j.version}</version>", "             </dependency>", "+            <dependency>", "+                <groupId>org.apache.logging.log4j</groupId>", "+                <artifactId>log4j-to-slf4j</artifactId>", "+                <version>${log4j.version}</version>", "+            </dependency>", "+            <dependency>", "+                <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>", "+                <artifactId>jul-to-slf4j</artifactId>", "+                <version>${slf4j.version}</version>", "+            </dependency>", "         </dependencies>", "     </dependencyManagement>", " "]}], "userModified": false, "replaceAll": false, "contentNotInModelContext": true}, "origin": null}

{"kind": "AssistantMessage", "content": [{"text": "Everything verified. Summary:\n\n## Root cause\nTwo problems compounded to produce the `NoSuchMethodError`:\n1. **Two competing SLF4J bindings** were declared directly: `logback-classic:1.2.3` and `log4j-slf4j-impl:2.20.0`. Both ship a class named `org.slf4j.impl.StaticLoggerBinder` \u2014 having both on the classpath is the classic \"multiple bindings\" trap, and which one actually gets resolved at runtime is not guaranteed to match the slf4j-api it was built against.\n2. **Version drift**: the explicit `slf4j-api:1.7.25` and `logback-classic:1.2.3` were far older than what `spring-boot-starter-web:2.7.14` (wants 1.7.36 / 1.2.12), `kafka-clients`, and the Elasticsearch client expected, so Maven's \"nearest wins\" rule pinned the whole project to a mismatched, stale pairing.\n\n## Fix applied to `/app/service/pom.xml`\n- Removed `log4j-slf4j-impl` (the second, conflicting SLF4J binding) and the stale explicit `slf4j-api`/`logback-classic` declarations \u2014 Logback now comes transitively from `spring-boot-starter-logging` as the sole binding.\n- Added a `dependencyManagement` block pinning `slf4j-api` (1.7.36), `logback-classic`/`logback-core` (1.2.12), `log4j-api`/`log4j-to-slf4j` (2.17.2), and `jul-to-slf4j` (1.7.36) to single, mutually-compatible versions. (Deliberately scoped to just these artifacts rather than importing the full `spring-boot-dependencies` BOM \u2014 that BOM also silently downgraded `org.elasticsearch:elasticsearch` from 7.17.13 to 7.17.11, which I caught and avoided.)\n- Added `<exclusions>` on `kafka-clients` and `elasticsearch-rest-high-level-client` for their transitive `slf4j-api`, so only one copy of that class is ever on the classpath.\n\n## Verification\n- `mvn dependency:tree -Dverbose`: zero \"omitted for conflict\" entries for slf4j/logback/log4j; exactly one binding (`logback-classic:1.2.12`) and one `slf4j-api:1.7.36` across Spring, Kafka, Elasticsearch, and Hibernate.\n- `mvn clean compile`: BUILD SUCCESS.\n- `mvn test`: 4/4 tests pass, with real log lines emitted at DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR \u2014 confirming the binding resolves and works at runtime, not just at compile time."}], "model": "claude-sonnet-5", "parent_tool_use_id": null, "error": null, "usage": {"input_tokens": 2, "cache_creation_input_tokens": 2526, "cache_read_input_tokens": 74373, "cache_creation": {"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens": 2526, "ephemeral_1h_input_tokens": 0}, "output_tokens": 4, "service_tier": "standard", "inference_geo": "global"}, "message_id": "msg_011CfkJE4h8RnxSpmVpYtCN1", "stop_reason": null, "session_id": "9ea8b4e3-b3bb-4c03-8625-05f43f4d3ec5", "uuid": "139dba14-0f2c-4b46-8551-5531673e2e2f"}
